name: compose-host-namespace-sharing
task_triggers: adding a service to a compose file
configuring container networking or process isolation
attack_scenario: With pid: host a container can read /proc of host processes to steal secrets and signal/kill them; with network_mode: host it binds directly to host interfaces and sniffs traffic of other services, bypassing published-port scoping.
negative_test_hint: deploy a compose service with "pid: host" and assert the policy check rejects it because the container could read host /proc and signal host processes

exemplar.explanation: network_mode/pid/ipc/userns_mode: host share the host's network, process, IPC, or user namespace with the container, collapsing the isolation boundary Docker exists to provide; userns_mode: host also disables user-namespace remapping. Keeping the default bridge networking and private namespaces preserves container isolation.
